correctness.rationale: Complete symbolic factor decomposition proves each candidate pair must use one marker and a position in a maximum zero run. Exact one-marker extension rectangles and their diagnostic factor intervals give necessary and sufficient conditions in all inequality/equality cases; reversal handles the second marker. The formula, resonance and simplex expectation (10/27) follow algebraically, not from finite enumeration. Two separate literal-factor checkers verified 1000 exact triples and 4220 proposed pairs.

value.rationale: All optimizers rather than the known minimum size are enumerated for a natural full three-parameter two-marker binary word class. The complete sharp position-set classification, extreme all-pairs equality phenomenon, and nondegenerate simplex limit with mean 10/27 offer a mathematical benchmark for attractor multiplicity beyond mere compressibility. This is a structural family, not an arbitrary isolated parameter slice.
